Chapter 1324: 9: A New Temporal Lifeform?

Chapter 1324: Chapter 9: A New Temporal Lifeform?

The entire human civilization was stirred because of the ‘update’ of the treasury.

But for Lin Yuan, who caused all of this, it wasn’t of much concern.

After bestowing numerous dimensional treasures, he no longer intervened.

How these dimensional treasures are exchanged and how many merit points are spent are all measured by the three goddesses.

After the human civilization stepped out of their hometown universe, Lin Yuan intervened several times to ‘upgrade’ the three goddesses.

Now, the power of the three goddesses is estimated to be unmatched, even by the greatest saints.

And Lin Yuan has never changed the stance of the three goddesses; they all stand by the side of human civilization.

“Parents…”

Lin Yuan’s deep gaze penetrated through the Chaos Void.

Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong, husband and wife, were already arranged by Lin Yuan to reside in one of the thirty-three Postnatal Universes.

The thirty-three Postnatal Universes are the strongest sanctuaries Lin Yuan left for human civilization, allowing only exits, not entries.

Under the protection of the Spirit of the Universe within the Postnatal Universe, Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong are said to be absolutely safe.

As for the lifespan limit under Level Twelve life?

If you rely purely on resources to accumulate, the limit is Level Eleven Perfect.

Theoretically, the strength of the physical body, the determination of the soul, and even the understanding of rules can all be enhanced through external forces.

But from Level Eleven to Level Twelve? It requires an incredibly firm will to make the ultimate leap; only success lets you enter Level Twelve.

Failure means death, suffering a backlash from the long river of time in the Chaos Void.

However, the possibility of Lin Yuan’s parents making the ultimate leap to Level Twelve isn’t very high.

This is also determined by Lin Yuan through observations of future timelines.

Yet the extension of lifespan limits doesn’t necessarily rely on reaching Level Twelve.

The essence of the lifespan limit for Level Eleven and below is because their fundamental life imprint is etched within the current universe’s river of time.

If the universe undergoes a great destruction, the river of time will wither and collapse, and any fundamental life imprint will collapse as well.

When Lin Yuan was at Level Eleven, with his Flesh Soul Perfection, his lifespan was endless, but he would still fall with the universe’s great destruction.

But what if the universe doesn’t undergo a great destruction?

So.

Lin Yuan has long transferred his parents’ fundamental life imprint to the river of time within the Postnatal Universe.

The thirty-three Postnatal Universes are Lin Yuan’s painstaking creations, free from so-called great destruction and rebirth, coexisting with the Chaos Void.

The fundamental life imprints of Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong are etched within the river of time in the Postnatal Universe, so their lifespan limits naturally do not exist.

This is something Lin Yuan specifically did for his parents.

That Postnatal Universe is vast and endless, offering all forms of entertainment thanks to human civilization’s modifications, enough for Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong to live happily forever.

After splitting a part of his mind to descend into the Postnatal Universe to accompany his parents.

The majority of Lin Yuan’s mind continued to observe the Chaos Void.

With Lin Yuan’s deepening observation, the essence of the Chaos Void displayed itself bit by bit in his eyes.

“That is…”

Lin Yuan saw the deepest part of the Chaos Void, where it is the end of all space-time, threads of time power permeating, forming loop regions made entirely of time.

“The time loops that past Chaos Realm Perfect beings fell into when charging Level Thirteen?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself; these loop regions made entirely of time, even he couldn’t see through them, filled with the aura of supreme rules from endless dimensions.

No matter which dimension or Dimension Heaven and Earth, as long as one charges Level Thirteen, they’re destined to fall into a time loop, clearly an iron law set by supreme rules.

Thus, each time loop is concealed and protected by supreme rules.

“Too many.”

Lin Yuan glanced and saw numerous time loop regions scattered around; however, almost all of them had fallen into complete silence, clearly with no hope for the Chaos Realm Perfect inside to escape.

“Moyu Tower Master…”

Lin Yuan looked at a time loop close to the deep regions and determined through faint causal sensing that this loop belonged to the Moyu Tower Master.

Once the invincible Great Saint who swept across an era of the Chaos Void.

The time loop region occupied by the Moyu Tower Master is much larger than those of the surrounding loops.

Even at Chaos Realm Perfect, there are strengths and weaknesses, like ordinary Great Saints, peerless Great Saints, and invincible Great Saints.

This not only manifests in strength but also in the time loop region occupied when charging Level Thirteen.

The stronger the strength, the larger and wider the time loop region occupied.

“There shouldn’t be much hope for normal breakthrough.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

After falling into a time loop at Chaos Realm Perfect, it’s naturally better to break through sooner than later.

Breaking through within a cosmic era is best, swiftly in hundreds or thousands of years.

The longer the delay, the lower the possibility of breakthrough.

The era of the Moyu Tower Master is separated from now by long cosmic eras, leaving basically no possibility for breakthrough.

“After entering Level Thirteen, breaking the time loop where the Moyu Tower Master is could be attempted.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Level Thirteen time life forms cannot peer into the contents of a time loop, but they can forcibly break it.

It just requires a price, no time life form is willing to do so lightly.

But Lin Yuan has causal ties with the Moyu Tower Master and received many of the other’s leftover benefits.

If the cost of breaking the time loop isn’t too high, Lin Yuan would be willing to give it a try.

Of course, even if the time loop is broken by external force, the life inside, though regaining freedom, loses the possibility of becoming a Level Thirteen life form.
